settings.title: What's included
settings.content: Three pieces, one meaningful place: the 4-sided bar necklace, cuff bracelet, and coordinates ring. Each piece is laser-engraved with your coordinates, and we send a photo proof before shipping.

settings.title: How engraving works
settings.content: 1. Enter your coordinates once (or tap “Find my coordinates”). We place the latitude on the necklace front, longitude on the back, and the full pair on the bracelet and ring. 2. Add up to two more necklace sides free, or engrave each piece with a different place. 3. Review the photo proof of all three pieces before we ship.

settings.atc_label: Add to cart — free engraving on all three pieces
